conversation.message: It's a common misconception, but quantum entanglement doesn't violate the speed of light because no information is actually being transmitted faster than light.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: This is because you can't control what state each entangled particle will be in when measured, so no message can be sent. The correlation is instantaneous, but the information exchange is not.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
